item.description: Spot XRP trade volumes on Upbit and Binance have spiked over the last 1 hour, as both exchanges battle to secure the top spot. Coinglass data confirms this trend.Visit Website

item.title: XRP ETFs Record Largest Volume in Five Trading Days Amid $10.63M Inflow
item.description: XRP ETFs extend the current inflow streak with $10.63 million in daily net flow, as their total traded value reaches a five-day high. Specifically, data from SosoValue shows that the five US XRP spot ETFs recorded a daily trading volume of $44.11 million on January 14.Visit Website

item.description: Ethereum shows improving momentum, holding above key support levels, with traders eyeing potential upside. Ethereum (ETH) has seen a 1.1% pump in the past 24 hours, trading between $3,281 and $3,386, a somewhat healthy price action.Visit Website

item.title: 2026 Is the Year of XRP Ledger DEX, Says Top XRP Validator
item.description: Confidence is building across the XRP community that 2026 could mark a turning point for the XRP Ledger’s decentralized exchange (DEX). Developers, validators, and Ripple executives are highlighting the network's accelerating progress in DeFi.Visit Website

item.title: Digital Asset Treasury Firms Spent $49B to Buy Bitcoin and Crypto in 2025
item.description: Digital asset treasury companies poured more than $49 billion into Bitcoin and crypto through 2025, according to CoinGecko's latest annual report. Per the report, these firms emerged as major buyers even while the crypto market struggled through one of its toughest cycles since the 2022 bear market.Visit Website

item.title: SWIFT Tests Tokenized Bond Settlement With Societe Generale’s EURCV Stablecoin
item.description: Societe Generale has completed a blockchain settlement test with SWIFT, showing that tokenized bonds can move smoothly between blockchain networks and traditional financial systems. The pilot suggests that regulated stablecoins and existing payment systems can work together, rather than compete.Visit Website

item.title: Stablecoin Yield Will Attract $6 Trillion in Bank Deposits: Bank of America
item.description: Bank of America has highlighted the threat that stablecoins would pose for US banks and their operation if they incorporated yield-bearing features. Its CEO, Brian Moynihan, told reporters during the company's quarterly earnings call on Wednesday that banks would see a massive liquidity outflow into stablecoins.Visit Website

item.title: BNB Completes 34th Quarterly Burn, Eliminating $1.27B Worth of Tokens
item.description: The BNB ecosystem has carried out its 34th token burn as part of its quarterly series, reducing the total supply of BNB. In the latest round, the BNB Foundation confirmed the incineration of 1.372 million BNB tokens, with a market value of $1.277 billion.Visit Website

item.title: $1,000 XRP Is Far Away, “The Earth Is Not Ready for This”
item.description: A popular crypto YouTuber is countering claims that XRP is heading straight to $1,000, arguing that such expectations are far ahead of current market realities. Specifically, this view emerged from crypto commentator Mason Versluis, who said on X that XRP holders need a “reality check.” He stressed that a four-figure price is not something he expects in the near term.Visit Website
